seo.title: THE HAMPTON GROCER brand Recalled Over Salmonella Risk
seo.description: THE HAMPTON GROCER is recalling brand over a salmonella risk.

paragraphs: THE HAMPTON GROCER is recalling brand because of a salmonella risk, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. The recall was initiated on August 14, 2026.

body.heading: What is being recalled
paragraphs: THE HAMPTON GROCER brand; Lacnola; SMALL BATCH LACTATION GRANOLA, 8oz, stand up pouches; NUTRIENT DENSE INGREDIENTS + MORINGA; SUPPORTS + PROMOTES HEALTHY LACTATION; INGREDIENTS Organic Gluten Free Oa

body.heading: Why it is being recalled
paragraphs: Product may be contaminated with Salmonella.

body.heading: Where it was sold or distributed
What consumers should do
paragraphs: Consumers can review the FDA recall record for product and distribution details.

body.heading: Source
paragraphs: This article was produced from an official FDA recall record initiated on August 14, 2026. U.S. Food and Drug Administration is the original source of this recall notice.
